jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?  Do you like to work precisely? Do you like working in 2 shifts?

Working at Sharp has many advantages.
Wij bieden
• Task variation: you change tasks approximately every half hour
• Salary: €16.2115 /hr gross   6% Shift bonus with meal vouchers of €8.80/day worked
• 2 shifts
• Training on the job (in-house training)
• No physically demanding work
• Very clean environment
• Free coffee, soup, and water
• Long-term position with the chance of a full-time contract
• If you get a full-time contract, your salary package is supplemented by group insurance and hospitalisation insuranceWij vragen
• Can you work precisely and cleanly?
• Do you speak and write proper English? This is important as you will be working with medicines.
• In addition, you are energised by working in a team and you are easy-going.
• Hygiene rules (no piercings, makeup, fake nails, etc.)
• Do you like to learn all the time? Then you have come to the right place, Sharp.
.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem and Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about logistics? Join our team at SAESB as a Logistics Administrator and play a vital role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across our operations.Your role:Are you detail-oriented, well-organized, and interested in logistics processes? We are looking for a Logistics Administrator to manage the entire administrative process for shipping and receiving goods. You will ensure timely deliveries while monitoring compliance with customs regulations.Your responsibilities:Administrative support for goods movement:

• Prepare shipping and receiving documents (such as Air Waybills and pro forma invoices).
• Create and follow up on purchase requisitions and orders in the ERP system.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date data in IT systems.
Transport coordination:

• Schedule and monitor all transport bookings, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Customs compliance:

• Verify and ensure adherence to applicable customs laws and regulations.
• Review documents for inbound and outbound shipments.
Reporting:

• Prepare and submit periodic reports on imports and exports.
Your Impact:

• Serve as the first point of contact for daily transport-related queries.
• Ensure timely and complete administrative handling of shipments and related reporting.
• Maintain proper documentation for customs and compliance purposes.

Your profile:

• A higher education degree.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role.
• Solid proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems.
• Practical knowledge of ADR regulations, customs laws, and Incoterms (or willingness to follow training).
• Understanding of logistics operations, including both road and air freight.
• A structured and precise approach, consistently following established procedures.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset, able to anticipate and prevent issues.
• Flexibility to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Able to work independently after a six-month training period.
• You have excellent knowledge of English and a good understanding of Dutch or French, sufficient for both internal communication and contacts with external suppliers.

You will join an international finance environment with operations across several European countries. Based in the Brussels region, the accounting team supports multiple entities and works closely with controlling, business finance, and external advisors. English serves as the primary working language.

This Senior Accountant position goes beyond traditional accounting. You will take on a central role in the month-end closing process, bring structure to complex accounting operations, and have the opportunity to drive digitalization, automation, and process improvement initiatives.

Senior accountant - Job omschrijving

• You independently manage the month-end closing process, maintain oversight of the end-to-end accounting cycle, and contribute to the development of an efficient finance organization.
• You lead process improvement initiatives across accounting, reporting, and audit activities, while actively supporting digitalization, automation, and optimization projects.

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst

Blue Pimento is looking for a Business Analyst to support the design and continuous improvement of processes and tools for both individual and professional customers in Finance/insurance.
Key responsibilities

• Business Analysis: Gather, analyze, prioritize and document business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories and process flows.

• Process Optimization: Assess existing processes, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to digital transformation initiatives, including partner portals, automation and self-service solutions.

• Solution Design & Implementation: Work closely with business, IT, architecture, operations and compliance teams to design suitable solutions, support user acceptance testing (UAT) and facilitate change management.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Organize workshops and presentations, engage key stakeholders and ensure that transformation initiatives meet business objectives.

• Agile Delivery: Actively contribute to team activities, backlog management and Agile ceremonies, promoting Agile values and principles.

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst (+ 5 years).

• Bachelor in information technology, software engineering, computer science, or related field

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies, backlog management tools and team ceremonies.

• Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to understand diverse stakeholder needs while maintaining a global perspective.

• Ability to engage stakeholders, influence decisions and build commitment.

• Fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

Blue Pimento Company Profile

Dynamic Consultancy services firm with a human scale, based in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, Blue Pimento is dedicated to development and deployment of business-oriented platforms. We help mid-sized companies in maximizing the business value of their information systems changes.

The success of Blue Pimento is based on Quality & Flexibility of the work performed by its consultants and most of the repeating assignments results from our customer's confidence.

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues

Talencia is looking for a “Data Business Analyst” for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Long term vision

 

Context :

We are looking for an experienced Data Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and Data Engineering teams. In this role, you will play a key part in translating business needs into scalable data solutions while supporting the transformation from an SAP-based landscape to a modern cloud data platform. You will contribute to both the maintenance of the current SAP BW environment and the evolution of the future data architecture.

Description :

As a Data Business Analyst, you will gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into functional and technical data specifications. You will design data mappings, transformation logic, and KPI definitions, while collaborating on conceptual and logical data models. Your responsibilities will also include SQL analysis, data profiling, and data quality assessments, as well as producing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Specifications. You will lead root cause analyses for data discrepancies and pipeline issues, define and execute testing and UAT activities, and contribute to data governance through documentation and metadata management. A strong background in SAP BW, SAP data extraction processes, SQL, data warehousing (ETL, Star/Snowflake schemas), and logical and physical data modelling is essential. Experience with Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SAP SD/MM, or within a retail or large enterprise environment is considered an asset. 

Your Profile :

You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, and have proven experience as a Data Business Analyst or in a similar consulting role. You are comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, with excellent communication skills that enable you to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are analytical, solution-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Fluency in English is mandatory, together with French or Dutch.

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Drive business growth in the German market by identifying new opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and managing the full sales cycle. Commercial experience is a plus, not a must: motivated juniors with strong German and English skills are welcome to apply for this 100% on-site role in Antwerp.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

 

Omschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.
 

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
